<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Auto_Retry_Range</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>Auto Retry Max must be 0 to 10, and Retry After (minutes) 1 to 1440.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Auto_Retry_Max__c)), OR(Auto_Retry_Max__c < 0, Auto_Retry_Max__c > 10)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Retry_After_Minutes__c)), OR(Retry_After_Minutes__c < 1, Retry_After_Minutes__c > 1440)))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>Auto Retry Max must be 0 to 10, and Retry After (minutes) 1 to 1440.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
